# A documented case carries a reader path of its own

## Statement
Where the material documents a case at a named company, the strongest reader path
runs from the case to what went wrong, to how it is done right, to what transfers.
**And now it also says that the transfer may be left out where the case speaks for
itself** — a changed statement, at the same version, with no change-log line.

## Applies when
feature documented_case is yes and feature named_company is yes

## Influences
- S-08 · `E-13.reader_path` — the ordered moves the strategy proposes.
- S-08 · `E-13.ending_intention` — what the ending has to transfer.

## Conflicts
None known.
